10 Days in South Korea: Seoul, Busan & Jeju Island

Ten well-paced days across South Korea's top three bases (Seoul, Busan, and Jeju Island) with regional food and scenic day trips.

Last reviewed: October 23, 2026 · Prices are approximate and for orientation only.

Route at a glance

Ten days is the sweet spot for a first trip to South Korea, connecting Seoul, Busan, and Jeju Island entirely by high-speed train.

Length10 days
Best forFirst-timers wanting the golden trio
BasesSeoul (4 nights), Busan (3 nights), Jeju Island (3 nights)
PaceBalanced

Transport & rail pass notes

All three bases are linked by fast, frequent KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail services.

What to book ahead

  • Intercity KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail tickets
  • Popular evening dining reservations

Ways to adapt this route

  • Fly open-jaw into one city and out of another to save backtracking.

Destination guides on this route

Seoul

Joseon royal palaces, hanok lanes, 24-hour night markets, K-culture and mountain fortress trails.

Busan

Coastal boardwalks, Haeundae & Gwangalli beaches, cliffside temples and Jagalchi seafood market.

Jeju Island

Volcanic craters, Hallasan mountain trails, waterfalls, haenyeo divers and coastal cafés.
